title: What If Every Cat in America Vanished Tonight?
subject: house cat

scenes.text: What if every cat in America vanished tonight? Wildlife would notice first.
Free-ranging cats kill an estimated 1.3 to 4 billion birds in the United States every year.
They also kill an estimated 6.3 to 22.3 billion mammals a year, mostly small ones.
Most of those kills come from cats living outdoors full time, not from pets with homes.
Even cats with homes still catch about 1.9 billion wild animals a year.
That is the estimate behind a major 2013 study. Your sofa would lose a pet, and wild birds would gain billions of lives.

description:
